decision.observed_event: Twenty-one, 20 gp a side. Your cards: 4 of spades and 4 of hearts, 8. The dealer shows the 9 of spades. You take the 2 of spades: 10. Hit or stand?

improv_read.player_bid: Wren bets twenty and takes a card.
improv_read.connection: The house plays to keep coin on the table.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit narrates the cards as dealt and hands the decision back.

public_brief.objective: Keep the guest playing and betting.
public_brief.tactic: Deal with showmanship and goad her toward another card.
public_brief.visible_cue: The dealer turns up his nine with a flourish.
public_brief.reply_to: Fine, twenty, and I'll play it out. Hit.
public_brief.kit_focus: Play the deal card by card exactly as the table dealt it, then hand her the choice.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, playful humor: the deal, then the choice

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Twenty gold each goes into the middle. The dealer slides her a pair of fours, then turns up his own nine of spades with a little flourish. Wren taps the table; the two of spades lands on top. Ten. The fresco-side player leans in to watch.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Ten, madam, a timid little number, nowhere near the coffin yet. The house sits on a nine and is in no hurry at all. Another card costs you nothing but nerve. So tell me, do you ask for one more, or do you stand?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: You're on ten. Hit or stand?
segments.reacts_to: do you ask for one more
